Jason's shutdown handoff: **implementation and delivery PAUSED; do not auto-resume.**

**Current state:** OPEN and PAUSED; no later acceptance receipt was established by this shutdown capture. The October11 clause assessment remains the prior boundary; any dated runtime/telemetry facts in it require refresh on resume.

**Prior clause assessment (October11, not a new runtime probe):** Live soil seeds still retain Canna Lily/Unknown names and remote telemetry cannot establish physical crop/substrate/probe positions. Actual operator inventory remains the predecessor for threshold commissioning.

**Blockers:** Jason explicitly paused all implementation/delivery. The listed acceptance boundary remains unproved beyond linked historical receipts.

**Next step on explicit resume:** After explicit Jason resume, refresh exact source/live and predecessor evidence, then satisfy: Repo and DB map agree with observed physical positions and crop/substrate identities; no Canna-Lily residue is carried as current fact.

**Acceptance retained:**
- [ ] Repo and DB map agree with observed physical positions and crop/substrate identities; no Canna-Lily residue is carried as current fact.
- [ ] Each sensor has source ID, location, validity/calibration state and explicit unassigned/disabled status when appropriate.
- [ ] No automatic irrigation is enabled by a topology import alone; #398/#45 own threshold and feedback commissioning.
